params.q: What is the current PPF interest rate in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the current PPF interest rate in India?

response.header: The most recently notified PPF interest rate is 7.1% per annum, unchanged for Q2 FY 2026–27 (July–September 2026), and no newer rate for Q3 appears in the supplied results.

text_blocks.snippet: Quick Answer: The latest confirmed PPF rate available from official announcements is 7.1% p.a., which has remained unchanged since April 2020 ClearTax+1 .

list.snippet: The Ministry of Finance kept the PPF rate at 7.1% p.a. for Q2 FY 2026–27 (July–September 2026) 1 .
snippet_highlighted_words: PPF rate at 7.1% p.a. for Q2 FY 2026–27 (July–September 2026)

list.snippet: Multiple independent financial sources also list 7.1% p.a. as the current rate for 2026, noting it has been unchanged since April 2020 1 .
snippet_highlighted_words: 7.1% p.a. as the current rate for 2026

list.snippet: PPF rates are reviewed quarterly (April, July, October, January), but the supplied results do not include an updated notification for Q3 (October–December 2026).

text_blocks.snippet: Because the government has not issued a newer rate in the provided data, the latest officially confirmed rate remains 7.1% p.a. This is the rate applicable until a new notification is released.
snippet_highlighted_words: latest officially confirmed rate remains 7.1% p.a.

list.snippet: PPF interest is compounded annually and credited on 31 March each year 1 .
The rate has been stable at 7.1% for over six years, making it one of the most consistent small‑savings instruments 2 .
snippet_highlighted_words: stable at 7.1% for over six years

list.snippet: Deposits made before the 5th of each month earn interest for that month 1 .

references.title: Govt Keeps Small Savings Interest Rates Unchanged for Oct-Dec
references.snippet: 1 PPF Interest Rate (Oct–Dec 2026): 7.1% p.a.This rate has remained unchanged since April 2020, marking one of the longest periods of stability in the scheme’s history. 1 The Government of India reviews small savings scheme rates every quarter. 2 PPF has stayed at 7.1% for over 25 consecutive quarters. 3 Interest is compounded annually and credited at the end of the financial year. 4 The rate applies uniformly to all existing PPF balances, regardless of deposit timing. The Ministry of Finance kept all small savings rates unchanged for the Oct–Dec 2026 quarter, including PPF, NSC, SSY, and others. The PPF interest rate remains one of the most stable government-backed returns available in India.

references.title: PPF interest rate October- December 2026: Has Public Provident Fund interest rate hiked for this quarter?
references.snippet: 1 The Ministry of Finance has kept the PPF rate steady at 7.1% p.a. for multiple consecutive quarters, including October–December 2026. 2 This rate has remained unchanged since April 2020, marking one of the longest stable periods for the scheme. 1 Tenure: 15 years, extendable in 5-year blocks. 2 Deposit Limits: Minimum ₹500 and maximum ₹1.5 lakh per financial year. 3 Tax Benefits: 3.1 EEE status — contributions (under old regime), interest, and maturity are tax‑free. 4 Interest Calculation: 4.1 Calculated monthly on the lowest balance between the 5th and last day of the month. 4.2 Credited annually on 31 March. 1 Before April 2020, PPF offered 7.9% (July 2019–March 2020) and 8.0% (October 2018–June 2019). 2 The rate is reviewed quarterly but has remained unchanged for over five years due to policy stability. The PPF continues to be a stable, government-backed, tax-efficient long-term savings option in India.
